sequence_points.name: Abstract Cityscape with Blue Tones
sequence_points.description: A large abstract painting depicting a cityscape with blurred vertical forms suggesting buildings, rendered in shades of blue and gray. The composition features soft, blended brushstrokes and a reflective surface at the bottom, possibly representing water or a street scene.

sequence_points.name: Seascape at Sunset
sequence_points.description: A vertical painting depicting a dramatic seascape at sunset, with dark waves in the foreground and a vibrant sky transitioning from orange to purple. The artwork is mounted on a wall with a simple frame.
